notes.subject: בבקרים
notes.rationale: o bɛ fɔ ko 'ni misiw ye' walima 'misiw la'; Septante (LXX) ye 'ji kɔnɔ' (bagamaro) dɔn — kumasen in kɔrɔ ka kɛ jujukɛye

notes.subject: לראש
notes.gloss: rosh ye daji-ni-kɛlenbaga ye (bɔninɛ); misali caman b'a fɔ ko 'bɔninɛ' walima 'sɩgama'

notes.subject: lɔɔni
notes.gloss: loʼan (לענה) ye jiri-ni-kurun ye min bɔninɛ nɔgɔya; Bamanankan t'a daɲɛ dɔnnen sɔrɔ, ka bɔfɔ-kɔrɔ sɔn

notes.subject: Yala ... wa?
notes.rationale: ɲininkali fila minnu bɛ kalanbagaw ka ɲɛ tilannen na, u bɛ u wele ka response

translation: Yala so-wɛrɛw bɛ se ka tulon kuru kan wa? Yala misiw bɛ se ka foro kɛ ⟨a la⟩ wa? Sabu aw yɛlɛma kɛ ɲɛnamaya kɛ daji ye, ka tiɲɛ jiriden kɛ lɔɔni ye.
